extraction: Vercel AI SDK Providers - AI Gateway: Part of AI SDK (v5.0.36+). Basic usage: model string 'openai/gpt-5.4' auto-routes through AI Gateway. Provider instance: import { gateway } from 'ai'; model: gateway('openai/gpt-5.4'). Config: baseURL (default https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v4/ai), apiKey (AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY env, supports Vercel personal/app access tokens), teamIdOrSlug (for multi-team tokens), custom headers. Observability for AI model usage through Vercel dashboard. Vercel Access Token Authentication for dynamic runtime auth of model requests.
